title: I Thank You With All My Heart

request.style: English, solemn male baritone solo with gentle choir backing, acoustic piano, cello, harp, soft strings, slow and reverent mood, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I thank you with all my heart
Before the gods I sing your praise
I bow down toward your holy temple
Giving thanks to your holy name
Your steadfast love and faithfulness
Exalted word above all else

[Chorus]
On the day I called you answered me
You made me bold with strength in my soul
On the day I called you answered me
You made me bold with strength in my soul

[Verse]
All the kings of the earth will thank you
For they have heard the words of your mouth
They will sing of the ways of the Lord
For the glory of the Lord is great

[Chorus]
On the day I called you answered me
You made me bold with strength in my soul
On the day I called you answered me
You made me bold with strength in my soul

[Bridge]
The Lord is exalted yet he sees the lowly
The proud he knows from afar
You have exalted your word above all your name

[Outro]
I thank you with all my heart
Before the gods I sing your praise
